resolutions.researcher_notes: Original current_ref (gas.in-en.com/html/gas-2751746.shtml) is confirmed dead: native site 404 (matches prior researcher's finding) and no Wayback snapshot exists (checked both wayback/available and CDX APIs directly, 2026-07-29). Fresh Chinese search surfaced the underlying regulatory filing: a 77-page EIA disclosure titled '环境影响评价报告公示：广西天然气支线管网项目忻城天然气支线管道工程环评报告' ('Guangxi Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Network Project -- Xincheng Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Engineering', prepared by 广西泰能工程咨询有限公司), uploaded 2018-06-02 to two document-hosting mirrors (docin.com and doc88.com -- same underlying document, not independent of each other, hence tier medium not high). This is a genuine independent trace of the project (contra the prior researcher's existence concern -- see summary) and its 2018 EIA-disclosure stage supports 'proposed' as the status at that time; I found no evidence anywhere (English or Chinese) of construction commencing since, so 'proposed' remains the best-supported characterization. Also found (but could NOT verify/cite -- see UNRESOLVED units) a reference to a formal NDRC-equivalent approval document '广西壮族自治区发展和改革委员会关于...忻城天然气支线管道工程项目核准的批复' (桂发改能源〔2017〕1682号) on www.in-en.com/datas/show.php?itemid=8&nid=65515 -- page is paywalled (会员登录/'members only') so the document number/date could not be confirmed against live content and url_verifier correctly fails on it; noted here only as a directional lead, not cited.

Same EIA-disclosure filing as Status (see that unit's note for the dead-link/replacement chain). The project title itself states '天然气支线管道工程' (natural-gas branch pipeline engineering), directly confirming Fuel=Gas. Two mirror hosts of one underlying document -> tier medium, independent=false.

The EIA filing (docin.com/doc88.com, see Status unit) confirms this is a '支线管道' (branch pipeline) but that term does not unambiguously map to GEM's transmission/distribution vocabulary without the design-pressure/diameter figures (which I could not access -- see Pressure/Diameter units), so I am not willing to stretch it to confirm 'transmission' specifically. No other source found with an explicit pipeline-type characterization. Leaving unresolved rather than inferring.

Could not verify ProposalYear/Month=2017-12 against any reachable page. The EIA disclosure I found (docin.com/doc88.com) is dated 2018-06-02, not December 2017 -- consistent with a late-2017 proposal preceding a mid-2018 EIA filing, but not itself an exact match, so I am not using it to source this specific date. A stronger lead -- a Guangxi DRC project-approval reply, '桂发改能源〔2017〕1682号' (bracket-year 2017, consistent with the recorded ProposalYear), found via search at www.in-en.com/datas/show.php?itemid=8&nid=65515 -- is paywalled (confirmed via direct fetch and via r.jina.ai proxy: page stops at a '会员登录'/members-only wall before showing the document number or date) and returns HTTP 403 direct, so it fails url_verifier and cannot be cited. Also checked: dnr.gxzf.gov.cn/sjcx/jsydys/t16422028.shtml (Guangxi Natural Resources Dept land-use pre-approval registry entry naming this exact project) times out on direct connection -- same geo-blocking pattern as the pre-flagged fgw.gxzf.gov.cn family -- and has NO Wayback snapshot (checked wayback/available + CDX, both empty). Leaving unresolved rather than citing an unverifiable page or a same-year-but-different-date proxy.

No reachable source states the 0.04 bcm/y capacity figure. The EIA-disclosure metadata pages (docin.com/doc88.com) confirm the project exists but only show a document listing/preview -- the 77-page report body (which would carry the design capacity) is not accessible without a paid download. The paywalled in-en.com approval-reply page and the geo-blocked/unarchived dnr.gxzf.gov.cn registry entry (see Proposal unit note) were also checked and do not yield this figure. Leaving unresolved.

Same situation as Capacity -- no reachable source states the 4.00 MPa design pressure. Checked the same leads (EIA-filing metadata pages, paywalled approval reply, geo-blocked/unarchived land-use registry entry); none expose the report body with this figure. Leaving unresolved.
Same situation as Capacity/Pressure -- no reachable source states the 29.00 km length. Checked the same leads; none expose the report body or a text announcement with this figure. Leaving unresolved.
Same situation as Capacity/Pressure/Length -- no reachable source states the 273 mm diameter. Checked the same leads; none expose the report body with this figure. Leaving unresolved.

Same EIA-disclosure filing as Status/Fuel (see Status unit note). The project title names '忻城' (Xincheng) directly, within a 'Guangxi Natural Gas Branch Pipeline Network' project -- supporting StartLocation=EndLocation=Xincheng and State/Province=Guangxi. The source itself does not name 'Laibin' as the prefecture; that Xincheng County (忻城县) sits within Laibin City's jurisdiction is standard, uncontested Chinese administrative geography, not something asserted by this particular filing -- noting the distinction rather than overclaiming what the ref supports directly.

No reachable source states the RMB 107,250,000 (2017) cost figure. Checked the same leads as Capacity/Pressure/Length/Diameter; none expose the report body or a separate cost announcement with this figure. Leaving unresolved.

A DuckDuckGo search snippet claimed doc88.com's page text read '建设单位： 广西广投天然气管网有限公司' (construction unit: Guangxi Guangtou Natural Gas Pipe Network Co Ltd -- an exact match to the recorded Operator). I could NOT reproduce or confirm this against the live page: a direct curl fetch of the raw HTML does not contain the string '广西广投天然气管网' anywhere, and python scripts/url_verifier.py explicitly FAILS on that token for this URL (200 but missing expected). Since I cannot verify the snippet against actual page content, I am not citing it -- treating the snippet as unreliable/unconfirmed rather than fabricating support. No other source found naming an operator for this specific segment (Guangtou is a real, active Guangxi gas-network operator generally, per the prior researcher's row shard, but that alone doesn't tie it to this project). Leaving unresolved.
